additional_info.subject: ID0388122-DC/Si-D/FR[170002507] - Router connectivity CRM:00315002020
additional_info.body:
Hello Fabien, good afternoon.
I accessed the charger remotely and found that the WAN Failover was turned On for the wired connection. As such, if the mobile connection was dropped it might've never recovered due to this config.
I would say to keep this ticket open 1week and if it reoccurs please inform me imediately and do not reboot the charger. We need to understand what failed in the router setup.
Thank you !
Best regards,Francisco
